NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - daily_calorie_target: "Moderate deficit ~300..500 kcal below estimated maintenance; adjust per weight changes and symptoms"
    - protein: "1.2..1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day, prioritize across meals"
    - carbohydrate_strategy: "Distribute carbohydrates evenly across meals to reduce postprandial spikes; include low-GI choices"
    - fats: "20..35% of calories, focus on unsaturated fats"
    - fiber: "Aim for 25..35 g/day from vegetables, legumes, whole grains"
    - timing: "Prefer balanced meals every 3..5 hours; include protein at each meal"
    - pre_exercise_snack: "If >3 hours since meal or on medication guidance: small snack with carbs + protein (e.g., yogurt and fruit) to reduce hypoglycaemia risk"
    - post_exercise: "Include protein (20..30 g) and moderate carbs to aid recovery and glycaemic stability"
    - fasting_and_IF: "If considering intermittent fasting, start conservatively (12-hour overnight fast) and coordinate with clinician before longer fasting; schedule key workouts within eating window or use small pre-exercise snack"
    - cheat_meal_policy: "One planned cheat meal per week (preferably on Sunday). Limit extra calories to ~300..600 kcal above usual meal, include protein/vegetables, avoid excessive alcohol"
    - meal_examples_pre_workout:
        - "150 g plain low-fat yogurt + 30 g berries (~20 g carbs, 12 g protein)"
        - "1 small slice whole-grain toast + 1 boiled egg (~20 g carbs, 6..8 g protein)"
        - "30 g oats with 1 scoop protein (~25 g carbs, 20 g protein)"
    - quick_post_workout_snacks_examples:
        - "150 g low-fat Greek yogurt with 30 g berries (~20 g carbs, 15..18 g protein)"
        - "Protein shake (20..25 g) with 100..150 ml milk + 1 small banana (~25..35 g carbs, 20..25 g protein)"
        - "150 g cottage cheese + 1 small apple (~20 g carbs, 14..18 g protein)"
    - monitoring:
        - "Check capillary glucose when symptomatic and when initiating fasted cardio, IF, or cheat meals; monitor pre/post higher-intensity sessions"
        - "Adjust carbohydrate amounts based on glucose responses and session intensity"
    - hydration: "Maintain regular hydration; consider electrolytes for long/sweaty sessions"
    - behavioral:
        - "Aim for consistent meal patterns, portion control, and progressive NEAT (e.g., walking after meals)"
        - "Prioritise sleep 7..9 hours and stress management"
